context: The Liquidity Pool showed a real XRBC image but plain XRP text. A local CC0-1.0 XRP SVG was added and wired into the existing dynamic token renderer so XRP identity remains visible after pairUI rebuilds the quote unit.

assets.runtime_policy: Use the local project asset; do not hotlink the upstream icon host.

integration: Initial XRP deposit quote unit includes the local XRP logo.
pairUI dynamic quote-unit rendering preserves the XRP logo.
XRBC/XRP pair picker can display paired XRBC and XRP logos.
Shared CSS exposes .xrbc-token-logo and .xrbc-token-pair-logos for future pages.
safety_invariants: Token logo presentation does not define ledger asset identity.
No wallet, balance, AMM, signing, transaction or finality logic changed.
Use documented local asset provenance for reviewed third-party token icon resources.
